summary: Vermilion Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K (Report of Foreign Private Issuer) containing a Report of Voting Results from its annual general meeting held on May 6, 2026. The report details outcomes of ordinary resolutions on fixing director count at eight, electing eight director nominees, appointing Deloitte LLP as auditors, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. All resolutions passed with substantial majority support. This is a routine post-meeting filing with no special-situation characteristics such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activism. The filing merely fulfills Canadian continuous disclosure obligations; no US equivalent event is triggered.
